tools.name: start_sandbox
tools.description: Creates a 30-minute sandbox session of a Cnamio test application, without an account or credentials. Returns application_id, auth_token, expires_at and user_id. tools.name: start_signup
tools.description: Requests a free Cnamio account for an email address. tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Looks up where a domain's DNS is hosted and how the given records can be connected, without changing anything. Returns provider, setupType, connectMethods (contains api_token when the records can be created through the DNS provider's API with a provider token), nameservers, recordState for a single

tools.name: connect_domain
tools.description: Starts a manual connection of a domain: returns a job_id and the exact records the domain owner creates at their DNS provider, and Cnamio watches the authoritative nameservers for them for up to 72 hours. Changes no DNS.

tools.name: connect_domain_automatic
tools.description: Creates the given records at the domain's DNS provider through the provider's API, with an API token from the domain owner, and returns a job_id. Works for domains whose connectMethods include api_token. The token is used for this request only and never stored. Existing records are never deleted; th

tools.name: get_connection_status
tools.description: Returns the status of a connection: pending, in_progress, completed (connected) or failed (72 hours without propagation). A connected domain keeps being monitored (read-only): health is healthy, degraded (an optional record is gone, or the zone cannot be read) or broken (a required record is gone),

tools.name: recheck_propagation
tools.description: Checks the domain's authoritative nameservers again now for a connection still in progress and returns its status. At most once every 5 minutes per connection (429 before that); a connection already completed or failed answers 409 and nothing is checked.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: Lists the application's recent connections, newest first, optionally only those of one domain, one status or one monitoring health (broken: connected domains whose required records disappeared), up to limit. Needs the application credentials or an OAuth sign-in; a session token is refused.

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description: Creates a link (url) that lets whoever manages the DNS (an agency, the IT team) connect the given domains with the given records, without the application secret. tools.name: revoke_share_link
tools.description: Revokes a shareable connection link at once: it starts no more connections and cannot be restored. Connections already started from it go on. Returns the link with its revoked_at time.
